name: Starter Game
description: Vertex-built first-person shuttle defense: explore a compact shuttle, watch a camera-centered spherical starfield, and repel aliens transporting in from a hostile ship with a phaser.

props.label: First-person Camera
props.instructions: Drag/arrows to look. W/A/S/D moves, Shift sprints, click/Space/F fires the phaser, and R restarts after defeat.

metadata.setting: short federation-like shuttle craft interior under attack by alien boarders, with stars, the mother ship, and an alien raider visible through the forward viewport

camera.hint: Drag or use arrow keys to look. Use W/A/S/D to walk, Shift to sprint, and click, Space, or F to fire the phaser.

shuttle3d.controlsHint: Mouse over console + E pilot • W/S throttle flies to Mother Ship • after docking use W/A/S/D to explore ship decks • E operates ship doors and terminals

objective.bay-ops.label: Use the starboard interior access and bring Bay Operations online.

objective.restore-power.label: Reach Engineering Access and restore main power.

objective.survey-departments.label: Survey medbay and science, then proceed to the bridge.

objective.bridge-access.label: Proceed to the bridge and identify the enemy ship on the viewscreen.

objective.bridge-screen.label: Use the bridge viewscreen to track the enemy ship.

objective.enemy-track.label: Enemy ship tracked on the bridge tactical display.

objective.enemy-attack.label: Use the bridge tactical console to fire on the enemy ship.

objective.enemy-disabled.label: Enemy raider disabled. Hold the bridge and await next orders.
